jobs.description:
Role Details

Level: Senior/ Lead

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

Weekly hours: 3-4 days/ week

Location: Remote Europe, GMT/BST or CET friendly

Language: English, plus Spanish and/or Portuguese

 

In this role, you’ll be a senior technical advisor to city governments across North, Central and South America, working in both an advisory and a hands-on capacity to help them design, build and launch small scale pilots of new services for residents.

Working alongside experienced product managers, data scientists, AI engineers, and designers, you’ll help multidisciplinary city teams build in-house product development capability by prototyping and delivering digital products and services, many of which harness data and AI.

You won’t own the decisions, but you’ll shape them. You’ll guide cities through the full product development lifecycle, helping them weigh the strategic and technical trade-offs at each stage: how to design system and data architecture that’s right-sized for a pilot but built to scale, how to prototype and test possible solutions to validate assumptions, and when AI approaches such as machine learning or large language models are the right tool (and when they aren’t). You’ll roll up your sleeves to prototype and demonstrate what good looks like, while making sure your clients understand the reasoning well enough to own the outcome.

This role suits someone with the technical depth of a tech lead, and the judgement, communication skills and patience to lead through influence rather than authority. You’ll need to work fluently in English and in at least one of Spanish or Portuguese.

 

Key skills and experiences

  • Extensive hands-on technical experience, with strong knowledge of system and data architecture, data pipelines, DevOps and infrastructure, and a track record of delivering and deploying robust solutions end to end, from prototype to pilot, across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments, including legacy systems and resource-constrained ones, so that your recommendations are realistic and buildable.

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning approaches, including large language models, and experience deploying them or working alongside ML engineers to integrate them into products, with enough understanding to judge when they’re the right tool and how to build them in responsibly.

  • Experience taking products from early concept to first release, while laying foundations for scale, with a track record of rapid prototyping and assumption testing and a “show, don’t tell” approach that uses working prototypes to build shared understanding and inform decisions.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating closely with product managers, designers and other disciplines throughout the product lifecycle.

  • The ability to explain technical ideas and trade-offs clearly to audiences of all technical levels, from engineers to non-technical stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

  • Experience setting technical direction for a project or small team and guiding other engineers, as a tech lead or senior engineer.

  • Experience influencing technical decisions you don't directly control, whether in a consulting or advisory role or as an in-house engineer working across teams and with senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity and flexibility in problem solving, and comfort working through ambiguity and uncertainty in complex environments.

  • Professional working proficiency in English and in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with multicultural teams and on international projects.

  • Experience working with government or other public-sector organisations, or on services for residents and citizens.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, such as data privacy, bias and fairness, transparency, and the governance considerations specific to public-sector use of AI.

  • Experience supporting organisations to build their own technical capability, for example through coaching, mentoring or setting up new teams and practices.

Our hiring process

We’ve kept the process short and focused. Here’s what to expect:

1. Application & Video
As part of your application, we’ll ask you to record a short video (1–3 minutes, instructions below) describing a technical project — work or personal — that you really enjoyed working on.

  • Please record it in Spanish or Portuguese, whichever you speak fluently.

  • You don’t need to show your face — a voiceover on a screen share, or any other format you’re comfortable with, is fine.

  • We want to understand what the project was and why you enjoyed working on it. This isn’t a test of production quality; we’re interested in how you think and talk about your work.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.


How to record and submit your video

The simplest way is Loom (free, no download needed):

  1. Go to loom.com and create a free account.

  2. Click New video → Record a video in your browser. Choose Screen and camera or Screen only if you’d prefer not to appear on camera, and make sure your microphone is selected.

  3. Record your video — remember, 1 to 3 minutes is all we need. The free plan has a 5-minute limit, which is plenty.

  4. When you stop recording, Loom will open the video and give you a link. Click Copy link.

  5. Check the sharing setting is Anyone with the link can view.

  6. Paste the link into the Link to your video field on the application form.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We're growing fast across Melbourne, the UK, and Asia, and there's a finite window right now to set the standard for clinical AI in Australia before anyone else does.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise product, extending how Lyrebird serves hospitals, health services and multi-site groups: org hierarchy, SSO and provisioning, admin tooling, template governance, audit and usage reporting

  • Build and own the prioritisation framework for enterprise, with clear, written criteria for core and tailored work that the whole business can rely on

  • Bring several independent streams of enterprise requests into one set of priorities, so every request has a clear home, a priority and a rationale anyone can explain

  • Turn tailored customer requests into buildable solutions, and spot the ones that are really core product needs wearing a customer's name

  • Stand up the voice-of-customer loop, spending real time with senior customer stakeholders and making sure what they tell you shapes what gets built

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver features end to end, from Postgres, to API services, through UI optimisations, and user experiences.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F)

  • Référence : 261828S

  • Démarrage : Immédiat

  • Durée : Long Terme - Mission de 12 mois, avec intégration en CDI client ensuite

  • Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC

  • Zone géographique : Île-de-France (78)

  • Déplacements possibles : Oui, déplacements réguliers en Normandie et dans les Hauts-de-France

Contexte de la mission

Dans le cadre d'un projet majeur du secteur nucléaire, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication spécialisé en chaudronnerie nucléaire pour accompagner la structuration, la mise en place et le pilotage d'activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés, notamment en acier inoxydable.

La mission s'articule autour de deux sites de fabrication présentant des niveaux de maturité différents : le premier dispose déjà d'une expertise et d'une expérience confirmées en fabrication INOX, tandis que le second n'a encore jamais réalisé ce type de production.

L'objectif est d'accompagner le déploiement de cette nouvelle activité sur le second site, en s'appuyant sur les savoir-faire existants, tout en assurant la coordination, la transmission des compétences et l'harmonisation des méthodes de fabrication entre les équipes.

Cette mission nécessite une forte présence terrain, une solide expertise technique en chaudronnerie nucléaire et d'excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie pour fédérer les équipes et accompagner le changement.

Missions

  • Piloter et coordonner les activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés destinés au secteur nucléaire.

  • Participer à la mise en place et à l'organisation des ateliers de fabrication.

  • Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle activité de fabrication INOX sur un site industriel n'ayant jamais réalisé ce type de production.

  • S'appuyer sur l'expertise du site maîtrisant déjà la fabrication INOX pour faciliter le transfert de savoir-faire et de bonnes pratiques vers le second site.

  • Assurer la coordination technique et opérationnelle entre les deux sites de fabrication.

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre les premières lignes directrices et les méthodes de fabrication.

  • Concevoir, définir et mettre en place les gabarits et outillages nécessaires à la fabrication.

  • Accompagner la fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable, notamment à partir de tôles de 4 mm d'épaisseur.

  • Assurer le pilotage opérationnel et l'accompagnement technique des équipes de fabrication.

  • Participer activement à la formation des équipes et à leur montée en compétences sur les procédés de fabrication INOX.

  • Favoriser la communication, le partage des connaissances et l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les équipes des différents sites.

  • Structurer et formaliser les méthodes de fabrication ainsi que la documentation technique associée.

  • Élaborer et mettre à jour les documents nécessaires au suivi et à l'organisation de la production.

  • Apporter un appui technique et méthodologique aux équipes afin de garantir le bon démarrage des activités de fabrication.

  • Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles méthodes et pratiques industrielles.


  • Formation technique de niveau ingénieur ou expérience significative en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie.

  • Minimum 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie, principalement acquise dans le secteur nucléaire.

  • Expérience confirmée en pilotage de fabrication chaudronnée dans un environnement nucléaire.

  • Solide expertise technique en fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable.

  • Bonne connaissance des procédés de fabrication et de transformation de tôles INOX.

  • Expérience dans la mise en place, l'organisation ou le développement d'ateliers de fabrication.

  • Capacité à définir des méthodes de fabrication, des gammes opératoires et des gabarits de production.

  • Maîtrise de la documentation technique et des méthodes de fabrication industrielles.

  • Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment du Pack Office, pour la rédaction, la structuration et le suivi documentaire.

  • Expérience en encadrement fonctionnel, pilotage et accompagnement d'équipes de production.

  • Capacité à transmettre ses connaissances, à former les équipes et à accompagner leur montée en compétences.

  • Excellent communicant, capable de créer du lien entre les équipes, de faciliter les échanges entre les sites et de faire adhérer les collaborateurs aux nouvelles méthodes de travail.

  • Qualités pédagogiques, sens de l'écoute et capacité à fédérer des équipes présentant différents niveaux d'expertise.

  • Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer une activité industrielle en phase de démarrage.

  • Forte orientation terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à intervenir dans des environnements industriels exigeants.

  • Maitrise de la norme NF EN 1090.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.


Accountabilities
  • Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
  • AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
  • Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
  • Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
  • Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
  • Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
  • Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
  • E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
  • Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
  • Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

    • Requirements

  • Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
  • Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
  • Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
  • Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
  • Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
  • Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
  • English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
  • Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

    • Strongly preferred:

  • Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
  • Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
  • Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
  • Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
  • Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (Hands-On, Frontend)
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager who wants to spend 80% of their time writing code, not attending management meetings.

About the role

Are you an experienced Software Engineer who loves writing code, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers become better at what they do?

At Pigment, our Engineering Managers are engineers first.

Unlike traditional Engineering Manager positions, this role is designed for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in building software while taking on meaningful people-management responsibilities.

You'll spend approximately 80% of your time designing, coding and shipping production features, with the remaining 20% dedicated to coaching engineers, running regular 1:1s, providing feedback and supporting their development.

We're particularly interested in Senior Software Engineers who have naturally taken on coaching, mentoring or technical leadership responsibilities and are ready to develop further as people managers.

You don't necessarily need to have held an Engineering Manager title before. What matters most is your technical ability, your experience helping others grow and your motivation to combine engineering with people leadership.

You'll join Pigment's Reporting & Collaboration community, building sophisticated frontend experiences that help customers interact with complex data, configure workflows and make better business decisions.

 


What you'll do

🧑‍💻 Software Engineering (80%)

You'll remain an active contributor to our production codebase, working alongside other engineers on challenging frontend projects.

  • Write, review, refactor and ship production code regularly using React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • Design and build sophisticated user interfaces for interacting with large datasets, including filtering, visualisation and complex configuration.

  • Take ownership of engineering tasks and features from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment.

  • Solve challenging problems involving frontend performance, scalability, state management and user experience.

  • Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, debugging and architectural decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Tech Leads and Software Engineers to deliver high-quality features.

  • Contribute to AI-powered product experiences and use modern development tools where appropriate.

  • Maintain the same technical expectations and engineering standards as our Senior Software Engineers.

    • You'll continue to write production code, not simply oversee the engineers who do.


    📚 Coaching & People Management (20%)

    Alongside your engineering responsibilities, you'll help other engineers develop their skills, confidence and careers.

    • Coach and mentor engineers, sharing technical knowledge and helping them improve their problem-solving abilities.

    • Hold regular 1:1 meetings with your direct reports to discuss progress, challenges and career development.

    • Provide constructive feedback, recognise achievements and support individual development plans.

    • Help engineers establish clear goals and understand the skills required to progress.

    • Support performance reviews and development discussions, including more challenging conversations when necessary.

    • Work alongside Tech Leads to understand engineers' technical contributions and development needs.

    • Help foster a collaborative engineering culture where people continuously learn from one another.

      • At Pigment, technical leadership and people management are intentionally separated. Tech Leads own the technical direction of teams, while Engineering Managers focus on coaching and developing engineers alongside their own coding responsibilities.

      You'll initially focus on contributing as a Senior Engineer before gradually taking on direct reports.


Who we're looking for

You're an engineer first, with a genuine interest in developing people.

  • You have substantial professional software-engineering experience and are technically operating at a strong Senior Engineer level.

  • You're currently hands-on with production code and want coding to remain the majority of your working week.

  • You have strong frontend development experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • You've built complex, scalable applications, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics or data-intensive environments.

  • You have experience coaching, mentoring or supporting other engineers through code reviews, pairing, technical discussions or structured feedback.

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers improve.

  • You're interested in taking ownership of 1:1s, career development and people-management responsibilities, or already have experience doing so.

  • You're comfortable solving complex technical challenges independently while collaborating with others.

  • You care about product quality, engineering standards and delivering meaningful value to customers.

  • You're fluent in English. French is not required.

    • Previous formal people-management experience is a plus, but not a requirement. We're equally interested in strong Senior Engineers who have demonstrated the ability to coach others and are ready to take the next step.


Our interview process

Because Engineering Managers at Pigment spend approximately 80% of their time coding, they go through the same core technical assessments as our Software Engineers.

We want you to understand these expectations from the beginning.

1️⃣  Technical Screen

A technical discussion including a 15-minute code refactoring exercise.

AI assistance is not permitted during the refactoring exercise.

2️⃣  Live Coding

A hands-on algorithmic coding interview focused on problem-solving, code quality and technical reasoning.

AI assistance is not permitted.

3️⃣  System Design

A discussion exploring your approach to designing software systems, evaluating technical trade-offs and solving complex engineering problems.

4️⃣  Final Interview with the EML (Engineering Manager Lead)

A conversation exploring your motivation, engineering mindset, approach to coaching and alignment with Pigment's culture and expectations.

Important: Our Engineering Managers are assessed against the same senior technical engineering standards as our Software Engineers. This is a role for people who genuinely enjoy coding and want to keep doing it.


Is this role right for you?

You'll probably love this role if:

  • You enjoy writing code more than spending your day in management meetings.

  • You're a strong Senior Engineer who wants to help others grow.

  • You want to develop people-management skills without moving away from engineering.

  • You enjoy the challenge of balancing meaningful individual contributions with coaching responsibilities.

    • This probably isn't the right role if:

    • You're looking to move away from hands-on software development.

    • You prefer managing delivery, budgets and team strategy over building software.

    • You haven't written production code regularly for some time.

    • You're looking for a traditional Engineering Manager position where engineering work is mainly delegated to others.

      • At Pigment, you don't have to choose between being an excellent engineer and helping other engineers grow.


What you will get
  • Competitive salary
  • Equity
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto
  • Remote-friendly environment

This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

  • Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
  • Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
  • Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
  • Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
  • Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
  • Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
  • Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

  • AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

That is where you come in. 

As Chief Engineer, you will be one of the most important technical leaders at Hypersonica. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. 

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. 

If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. 


What you'll do
  • Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. 
  • Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. 
  • Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. 
  • Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. 
  • Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. 
  • Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. 
  • Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. 
  • Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. 
  • Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. 
  • Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. 
  • Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. 
  • Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. 
  • Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. 

    • Who you are
  • An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. 
  • Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. 
  • Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. 
  • Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. 
  • Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. 
  • Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. 
  • Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. 
  • Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. 
  • Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. 
  • Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. 
  • Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. 
  • Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. 
  • Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. 

    • You might have come from

    There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. 

    You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer. 

    You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. 

    We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. 


    What we offer
  • The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. 
  • A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. 
  • Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. 
  • Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. 
  • The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. 
  • The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. 
  • The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. 

    • The person we are looking for

    We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. 

    We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. 

    Someone who can bring clarity to complexity without slowing the organisation down. 

    If that sounds like you, come and build it with us.

jobs.title: Product Manager - B2B SaaS (Martech) - Europe
jobs.description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality.
 
What is our mission?
 
We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.
 
What are we offering?
 
Impact; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.
Personal Growth; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager.
Experience; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.
Delight; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.
Community; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.
 
What are we searching for?
 
Leadership, you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.
Communication, you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.
Problem Solving, you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.
Teamwork, you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them. 
Listening, despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.
Entrepreneurial Spirit, rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?
 

What You Will Do
  • Define the why, when, and what of the products our engineering team builds, leading cross-functional teams from ideation to launch.
  • Build a product and strategy that reflect Insider One’s vision, clearly articulating business value to align the team around each release.
  • Own and optimize the release process, coordinating all activities to bring products to market successfully.
  • Manage and prioritize initiatives, turning insights into actionable ideas by continuously tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies.
  • Define and analyze key product metrics to measure performance, customer satisfaction, and improvement opportunities.

    • What You Will Need
  • A Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university, preferably in Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with a B2B SaaS product.
  • Hands-on experience in Agile Product Development.
  • Exceptional decision-making and communication skills.
  • The ability to manage complex initiatives with limited supervision.
  • Fluent in English and Turkish, both written and verbal, as we have colleagues from all over the world.

    • What We Offer
  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
  • Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech & Dev Talks.
    • We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. 
     
    To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
     
    If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

    We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

    Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager, WebShop
jobs.description:
ABOUT YOU

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

ABOUT US
 
Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
 
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

    • Backlog & Roadmap Management

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.

  • Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

    • Change Management & Communication

  • Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.

  • Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.

  • Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.

  • Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

    • Operational Improvement

  • Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.

  • Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.

  • Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.

  • Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.


    • What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

    The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.

  • Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.

  • Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.

  • Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.


    • Skills & Experience

    Strong Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.

  • Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.

  • Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

    • Highly Organized

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.

  • Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

    • Diligent & Proactive

  • Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.

  • Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.

  • Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.

  • Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

    • Strategic & Operational Thinking

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

  • Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.

  • Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.

    •  
    Preferred Expenrience
     

  • Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.

  • Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.

  • Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience in gaming, payments, e-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

    • Benefits:
     
    We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes unlimited Flexible Time Off and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

jobs.description:
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).

LA MAISON
 
Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.

En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus.
 
Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits.

·       Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines.
·       Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence.
 
PROFIL

  • Deploy, maintain, and scale containerized services across Docker and Kubernetes environments using automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.

  • Advanced expertise in Python, with a strong background refactoring and rewriting production-critical code for performance and testability.

  • Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming API ingestion pipelines (REST, WebSockets) handling time-series datasets.

  • Solid production experience deploying and managing containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.

Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs :
 
1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving)
- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé.
- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers.
- Conteneurisation des solutions (Docker) et orchestration sur des clusters (Kubernetes) pour assurer la scalabilité et la haute disponibilité.

- Conception et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD dédiés au Machine Learning (réentraînement automatique, validation des modèles).

- Gestion du versioning des données et des modèles (DVC, MLflow) pour assurer la reproductibilité des expériences.

- Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU).
- Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD).
- Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel.
 
Votre rôle inclura également :
Monitoring avancé : Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives.
Collaboration transverse : Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production.
Évangélisation : Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science.

* Solide expérience sur les plateformes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et l'IaC (Terraform est un plus).
* Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps : MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes.
- Connaissances Data : Bonne compréhension des bibliothèques ML (Scikit-learn, Pandas) et Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch) pour pouvoir optimiser le code des Data Scientists.
- Expérience : Vous avez une expérience significative dans le déploiement de modèles ML en production (batch ou temps réel).
- Mindset :
* Rigueur absolue sur la qualité du code et l'automatisation.
* Goût pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture complexes.
* Capacité à travailler dans des environnements techniques hétérogènes.

We're building an AI-first data team. We use cutting-edge LLMs and internal tools to work faster, and we expect you to use and improve them. The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential.

Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you.


Your position in our team
  • Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow.
  • Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios.
  • Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default.
  • Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions.
  • Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack.
  • Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most.

    • Your profile
  • 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far.
  • Strong SQL and Python for data work.
  • Working with AI tools feels natural to you — and, just as important, the judgment to review and validate what they produce. You treat AI output as a draft to verify, not an answer to trust, especially where correctness is non-negotiable.
  • A solid grasp of data architecture and modeling principles (dimensional modeling, slowly-changing dimensions, incremental patterns) — or the drive to deepen it fast.

  • Working knowledge of relational and some exposure to non-relational Databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB).

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

jobs.title: Director of Brand & Creative
jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

We are looking for a senior creative leader to define the next chapter of Contentsquare’s brand and lead the evolution of our global Studio.

You will set the creative vision for how Contentsquare shows up in the world. Your mission is to elevate our brand, making it more distinctive, modern, and recognizable, and ensuring our creative expression positions us as a leader in our industry.

You will drive the creative evolution of our brand across every touchpoint, from campaigns and product launches to web, events, motion, and executive storytelling. You'll push creative boundaries, champion bold ideas, and set an exceptional standard for quality and differentiation.

A key part of the role is translating complex technology, data, and AI innovation into simple, compelling creative experiences. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, and GTM teams to understand what makes our platform unique and bring that story to life.

You'll also lead and transform our global Studio, developing a high-performing team of designers, creative leads, and agency partners. You'll evolve our brand system and embrace AI, automation, and self-service to scale production, freeing the team to focus on creativity, craft, and high-impact work.

Your mission: build a category-defining brand and a world-class, AI-enabled creative organization to bring it to life.


What you’ll own

Brand creative direction

  • Set the creative vision for Contentsquare and hold an exceptional standard across launches, campaigns, brand, web, events, and executive storytelling.

  • Champion bold ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and push the team beyond safe, predictable creative work.

  • Stay ahead of what the best brands are doing, in SaaS, AI, technology, and beyond, to create work that is unmistakably ours.

    • The team 

    • Lead, develop, and retain exceptional designers and team leads, building a high-performing culture of craft, bold thinking, ownership, and accountability. Empower the team to take creative risks and make strong decisions independently.

    • Build and manage a network of world-class agencies and specialist partners, bringing fresh perspectives and expertise. Own agency selection, creative direction, budgets, and performance, ensuring exceptional quality and the flexibility to scale during peak demand.

      • The platform and product story

      • Build a deep understanding of our platform, AI capabilities, and technology, keeping the Studio closely connected to our product and customers.

      • Partner early with Product and Product Marketing to turn complex technology into simple, compelling, and memorable creative experiences.

      • Bring our product story to life through distinctive design, motion, video, and storytelling across every relevant touchpoint.

        • The Brand System

        • Evolve our visual identity into a distinctive, recognizable, and scalable brand system that reflects our ambition as an AI leader.

        • Build reusable frameworks, templates, and self-service tools that help teams create effectively without compromising quality.

        • Know when to scale through the system and when an idea deserves something entirely new.

          • AI in the studio

          • Lead how the Studio uses AI across design, copy, production, and creative operations.

          • Use AI to absorb repetitive work and production volume, expanding creative capabilities and giving the team more time for ideas, craft, and innovation.

          • Help the team adopt new tools and workflows confidently, without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

            • How the creative studio runs

            • Own the Studio operating model, including priorities, resourcing, project management, creative reviews, and delivery across internal teams and external partners.

            • Build a fast, effective, and scalable operation that anticipates demand, manages production peaks, and removes unnecessary complexity.

            • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Web, Comms, and GTM teams, engaging early enough to shape the work rather than simply receive briefs.


What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years across design, brand, creative, or Studio leadership, including 5+ years leading teams in SaaS or technology.

  • Experience managing managers/team leads and operating in complex, global organizations.

  • Exceptional portfolio with a high creative bar across brand, digital, campaigns, and product storytelling.

  • Strong ability to turn complex technology and AI into simple, compelling creative narratives.

  • Deep understanding of SaaS/tech; AI or AI-native experience is a strong plus.

  • Proven experience evolving brand/design systems and scaling quality through templates and self-service.

  • Hands-on experience transforming creative teams with AI across workflows, automation, production, and enablement.

  • Strong command of Creative Operations, resourcing, agencies, and end-to-end Studio workflows.

  • Strong benchmarking instincts and a clear point of view on differentiation and creative excellence.
  • Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership skills.

    • You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

    • Have exceptional creative taste and a strong point of view on what our brand could become.

    • Understand the product deeply enough to find the creative idea within it, rather than waiting for a brief to define it.

    • Turn complex technology, data, and AI into simple, human, and memorable creative experiences.

    • Know what the best brands are doing, both in our category and far beyond it, and are more interested in what nobody has done yet.

    • Move confidently between setting creative vision, challenging the details, shaping product storytelling, and leading a high-performing team.

    • See AI as a way to take more creative risks, not fewer. Let it handle the volume so your team can focus on the work only people can do.

    • Build simple systems that keep creative teams fast, collaborative, and effective, while knowing which work deserves something entirely original.

    • Challenge work that's merely good enough, inspiring teams and agency partners to push for exceptional.

    • Balance bold creative ambition with a strong understanding of customer impact and business outcomes.


    What Success Looks Like

    Within your first year, we would expect to see:

    • A visibly higher and more consistent creative bar across the company.

    • A distinctive creative language for our platform, products, and AI capabilities that makes complex technology easier to understand and more exciting to experience.

    • A Studio that is deeply connected to Product and Product Marketing and engaged earlier in the storytelling process.

    • Strong differentiation from competitors across our visual identity, campaigns, product launches, and customer-facing experiences.

    • A strong, scalable brand and design system.

    • A clear Studio operating model with stronger prioritization, ownership, and delivery.

    • Meaningful adoption of AI across creative workflows, resulting in faster execution, better output, and expanded team capacity.

    • More teams able to self-serve effectively through high-quality templates, systems, and guidelines.

    • Strong leadership across the Studio, with team leads operating with greater autonomy and accountability.

    • Better balance between internal resources, agencies, automation, and self-service.

    • A Studio viewed by the business not as a production function, but as a strategic partner in how we bring our product and technology to the world.

    Why you should join Contentsquare
    We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
     
    Here are a few we want to highlight:
    - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
    - Lifestyle allowance
    - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
    - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
    - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

The Role:

As a Senior QA Engineer, you'll own quality across our product portfolio. You'll define and lead our quality strategy across the full platform, from backend services and agent orchestration through to omnichannel communications.

You'll work closely with engineers and product to build in quality from the start, not just a manual check at the end. You’ll design and execute tests to measure the quality of our AI agents, testing for probabilistic outputs, expected reasoning behaviours, performance and overall security.


What You'll Be Doing:

● Design and own the quality strategy for our AI agent platform, including approaches to testing non-deterministic, LLM-powered systems.

● Build and maintain automated test suites covering unit, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios across our TypeScript/Node.js/React/Python stack.

● Develop evaluation frameworks for agent behaviour, testing reasoning quality, tool use, memory, and multi-step interaction flows.

● Test and validate our omnichannel communication platform across channels: web, messaging, voice, and beyond.

● Collaborate closely with engineers and define acceptance criteria that catch issues early in the development cycle.

● Champion a culture of quality across the team, reviewing test coverage in PRs, advocating for testability in system design, and raising the bar for what "done" means.

● Use and help shape AI-assisted testing tooling to accelerate coverage and surface issues faster.


What We're Looking For:

● Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer on complex, production software products.

● Strong hands-on skills using test frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Jest).

● Experience testing APIs, backend services, and databases (PostgreSQL or similar).

● A clear understanding of how to approach testing non-deterministic systems.

● Experience designing and implementing QA strategy.

● Strong communication skills, you can articulate quality risks clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to have:

● Experience evaluating LLM or agentic systems, prompt behaviour, output quality, hallucination risks, or agent evaluation frameworks.

● Familiarity with performance, load, or chaos testing for real-time or event-driven systems.

● Background in automotive, dealership tech, or B2B SaaS.

● Exposure to AI-assisted development and testing tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code).

Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
 
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
 
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
 
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
 
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
 
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."
